caption:
i'm comparing my middle to everyone else's finish line.

maybe you are too.

send this to someone who's been too hard on themselves lately.

slides.text:
why does everyone else's life
look better than mine?

slides.query: why do we compare ourselves to others
slides.result: Psychologist Leon Festinger proposed that people judge themselves by **comparing to others,** especially when there's no objective way to measure.

slides.text:
and building something has no objective measure
so we compare
slides.image: standing on track lanes comparison identity

slides.text:
you see their highlights
they don't see your behind the scenes
slides.image: night run under bridge alone city

slides.text:
compare yourself to who you were last year
that's the only race you're actually in
